Definitions.Definition: -- ============================================= -- Author: <Author,,Name> -- Create date: <Create Date,,> -- Description: <Description,,> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AA_GET_MAX_UNITS] AS BEGIN DECLARE @START_ID int,@END_ID int SELECT @START_ID=START_ID,@END_ID=END_ID FROM SERVERS-- WHERE Serv_Name = @@SERVERNAME RETURN (select isnull(max(U_ID),@START_ID) from UNITS WHERE U_ID BETWEEN @START_ID AND @END_ID ) + 1 end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Unit_Delete] @U_ID int
AS BEGIN
--AS --BEGIN TRY --BEGIN TRANSACTION
IF ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM ViewBill_Contents WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM IMEX_Details WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM InSale_Details WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM Rtn_Contents WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0
AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM SB_Contents WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM Pch_Details WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM FRM_Contents_Details WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0
AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM FRM_Details WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM IM_Units WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM IM_Formating_Menu WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0
AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM IM_Struct_Menu WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(U_ID) FROM Store_Trans_Details WHERE U_ID = @U_ID ) = 0
BEGIN delete from Units where U_ID=@U_ID END ELSE BEGIN raiserror('لايمكن حذف وحدة عليها حركة',16,1,'خطأ') END
END
--COMMIT --END TRY
